book.name: Ibeliu
book.title: IBELIU MeIbeliu ꞌidi leta Yesu weyahina

content: Topwaoli Melikisedeki

Ma Melikisedekiina meSalema ꞌidi kini, ta Yehoba Tolohanena moisa ꞌina topwaoli. Mwalo hene Melikisedekiina Ebalahamo ꞌilobeya, tutaina loꞌaleha ꞌoinega ꞌihilama. Ta Ebalahamoina toloinao baibaiwadi ma ꞌadi bodao ꞌipeꞌudiya, ꞌoinega Melikisedeki gwae hemisa bwebweꞌana ꞌiꞌebwaeya Ebalahamo ꞌoina.

Coinega Ebalahamo ꞌina tobwatobwa ꞌiwatahidiya heꞌune ꞌadi baibaiwa nima luwaluwa, ta heꞌune ꞌaigeda Melikisedeki ꞌiꞌebwaeya ta Ebalahamo tauna naeni ꞌiꞌewediya. Ta Melikisedeki sanina ꞌana gibui “Toloina dumwaluna,” ta ꞌina tupwa sanina Salema, ꞌana bui “Daumwala,” ꞌoinega tasanasanapu ꞌabehega Melikisedeki tauna ꞌina loina daumwalina.
Melikisedekiina geya tamanamo ta geya sinanamo, ma wete geya ꞌina susumo ta ꞌina liꞌu ma ꞌina ꞌamasa geya ꞌadi tosanapumo, ma hesi gide tuwa Yehoba natuna ꞌihetopwaoli hataya Yehoba ꞌoina.
Moisa, Melikisedekiina ꞌaigeda bada lohanena, ta Ebalahamo ꞌilohane sineya, weyahina Ebalahamo ꞌina tobwatobwa ꞌoinega tupwana ꞌiꞌebwaeya Melikisedeki.

Ta topwaoli taudi Libai ꞌina bodao siꞌewaꞌewa ꞌidi tobwatobwa tupwana tauda Ebalahamo tubunao ꞌoidega. Taudi ma tauda susu ꞌaigeda, ta hesi ꞌadi loina ꞌimiyamiya sowasowana tobwatobwa siꞌewaꞌewa ꞌidi tomota ꞌoidiyega.

Melikisedeki hali susu, ta ꞌina miya lohanenamo, ꞌoinega tobwatobwa tupwana ꞌiꞌeweya Ebalahamo ꞌoinega. Coinega wete Melikisedeki ꞌina gwae hemisa Ebalahamo ꞌiꞌebwaeya. Ebalahamoina loheya madouna, weyahina mwalo Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa ꞌiꞌebwaeya,

ta hesi Melikisedeki Ebalahamo ꞌilohane sineya, weyahina taudi sanidi madouna ꞌidi gwae hemisa siꞌeꞌehele tomota taudi sanidi ꞌiꞌiudi ꞌoidiya, ꞌoinega wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega Melikisedeki ꞌina gwae hemisa ꞌiꞌebwaeya Ebalahamo ꞌoina.
Bewa tuwa Libai ꞌina bodao ꞌida tobwatobwa tupwana siꞌewaꞌewa. Taudi tomota tuwa ꞌamaꞌamasidi, ta hesi Melikisedeki wasana ꞌabehega tauna miyamiya hatayana.
Bewa tuwa ꞌida tobwatobwa tupwana taꞌeꞌehele Libai tubunao ꞌoidiya, ta mwalo ꞌana ꞌita gide Melikisedeki ꞌina tobwatobwa tupwana ꞌiꞌeweya Libai ꞌoinega,
weyahina Libai ꞌabwa tubuna Ebalahamo ꞌalona, saugaina Ebalahamo Melikisedeki ꞌedai ꞌilobeya, ta ꞌina tobwatobwa tupwana ꞌiꞌebwaeya.

Libai tubunao taudi ꞌidi paihowa beno Yehoba ꞌina loinao meIsileli tauda siheꞌitegita, ta loinaina geya sawasawahina ꞌiꞌabihedumwalu bwaibwainigita, ꞌoinega nuwanuwada ꞌaigeda topwaoli hauhauna ma ꞌiꞌabihe dumwalugita, topwaoliina gide Melikisedeki, ma geya Eloni matubunao gide.
Eeta ꞌeguma topwaoli hagana talagu, loina wete hagana talagu.
Tasanapuya ꞌabehega Keliso tauna ꞌida topwaoli hauhauna, geya Libai ꞌina susuwega ꞌinaoma,
ta hesi Yuda ꞌina susuwega ꞌinaoma, taudi geya hesinuwa siloba Mosese ꞌoinega ma sihetopwaoli.
Coinega ꞌida topwaoli hauhauna gide Melikisedeki.
Geya Mosese ꞌina loinega ꞌihetopwaoli, ta hesi yawasina miyamiya hatayana ma waiwaina ꞌoinega.
Tauna Yesu, ma weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌigwaeya,

Moisa, Mosese ꞌina loinao geya sawasawahidi ma ꞌaigeda toꞌaha siꞌabihe dumwalu bwaibwaini. Coinega loina nugenugetana taꞌebesineya, weyahina weꞌana, ma ꞌoinega hemisa hauhauna ta bwebweꞌana ꞌilatuma, ta hemisaina ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌoina talohoho.
Ta tauda ꞌida hemisa Keliso ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya. Yehoba mwalo Kelisoina ꞌoina ꞌiꞌetaꞌwataꞌwalulu, ta ꞌigwae hemisaeya, ma hesi topwaoliyao nugenugetadi geya gwae hemisa Yehoba ꞌoina siloba.
Ta Yesumo weyahina ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Bada ꞌigwae hemisa pwaiya ta ꞌowa ꞌuhetopwaoli hataya, ma ꞌina gwae hemisaina geyaꞌabwa ꞌiligeligehi.”

content: Coinega Yesu ꞌina loina hauhauna tasanapu bwaibwainiya ꞌabehega loina miyamiyaina ꞌibwebweꞌana sineya.
Mwalo topwaoli nugenugetadi baibaiwadi sipaipaihowa ꞌana siga siꞌamasa ta muliyetega hauhaudi sihemiyalaenedi.
Ta hesi Yesu tauna ꞌida topwaoli hataya, ꞌoinega geya ꞌana miyalaenamo.
Yesuina tuta mabwaiyana sawasawahina ꞌiꞌabihetegita ꞌeguma ꞌana hemisega taluhu Yehoba matana, weyahina Yesu miyamiya hatayana, ta tuta baibaiwana weyahida ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina.

Moisa, Yesuina sawasawahina ma ꞌihetopwaoli weyahida, weyahina tauna mumugana mabwaiyana ꞌausalana tuwa, ta geya gide togala tauda, ꞌoinega Yehoba Yesuina ꞌiꞌabilagasiya ta galewa ꞌana tomiyao ꞌilohane sinediya.

Ta topwaoliyao nugenugetadi sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda Yehoba ꞌoina sipwaopwaoli, taudi ꞌidi puiyao, ma tomota wete ꞌidi puiyao weyahidi. Ta hesi Yesu maꞌaigedamo wahina ꞌitagwaleya ta ꞌipwaoliyeya Yehoba ꞌoina weyahida.

Tuta nugenugetaidi ꞌoidiya Mosese ꞌina loinega tomota weꞌaweꞌadi sihetopwaoli madouna, ta muliyetega Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa ꞌoinega Natuna ꞌihetopwaoli, ma tauna mumugana bwebweꞌana miyamiya hatayana.
